answer: The bug was in `src/inner.rs` within the `reserve_entries` function. The condition `if try_add > additional || self.entries.try_reserve_exact(try_add).is_ok()` was incorrectly using an OR (`||`) instead of an AND (`&&`). This caused the function to return early even when it should have proceeded to reserve more capacity, leading to insufficient capacity in some cases. Reverting this to `if try_add > additional && self.entries.try_reserve_exact(try_add).is_ok()` fixes the issue.
